utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twenty-sixth. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, although someone's coming through twice.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's me, sorry. Laptop and headset. There, better?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Jamie Brennan's absent today, so it's just us.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Before we get serious, there's a birthday cake in the office. Quite a substantial one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Substantial as in enough for everyone, or you've already had a substantial bit?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm giving you useful information, David. Don't interrogate the source.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: He's definitely had some.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You can hear the guilt through Teams.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, excellent technical start. Let's have the updates.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I've got a few.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The monthly fire alarm test, that's all done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Tommo.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I tested the fire alarm panel yesterday. It's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good, that's reassuring.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The risk assessment for work on the Atlas is updated as well. All fine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the seals on the little water valve on two — replaced, that's sorted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: My leak inspection on the Main Water Isolation Valve has moved. That's now due on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, thanks, Tom.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mine's less cheerful. I can't get any further with the pre-use checks; can't get hold of the supplier.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, right. That's frustrating.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One cancellation as well: the filter swap on the tower isn't going ahead now. It's been rolled into next month's shutdown.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oh, and just an observation: I saw the pressure on the line 3 barrel dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, just something you noticed?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that's all it was.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. What's new from production, Callum?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We've got a jam on the spinner. It needs clearing and the sensors need checking. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say clear it or check the sensors? You broke up halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Both — clear the jam and check the sensors on the spinner.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, so not just a mechanical clear-out.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can anyone take that on?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take it, sorry. Haven't got the capacity.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Neither can I, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right... no taker for that at the moment, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: David, can you schedule downtime for the Atlas with production at half two? That's low priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, Sarah, I can't fit that in today. It'll need to be someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Haley, can you take that instead — schedule downtime for the Atlas with production at half two? Still low priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll schedule downtime for the Atlas with production at half two. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, just so I've heard that properly — that's arranging the downtime with production, not starting work on it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, just scheduling the downtime.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, got you. I was talking over the first bit.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else for this morning?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing from quality to add.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's my lot as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. The spinner is urgent, but we haven't got anyone taking the jam clearance and sensor checks.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Not the answer I'd hoped for, but understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On a slightly brighter note, the cake has proper icing. None of that dry sponge business.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's a very detailed report for someone who hasn't admitted eating it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No comment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that very convincing note — thanks, everyone.
